title: Talk time, interruptions and silence of a window or a consult

definition.doctor: doctor = role-layer doctor (REB role track llm-roles, joined to the consult's text track); patient / attender / staff / other are 'other'; role unknown is 'unattributed'. Never a voiceprint match (room_turn_speaker)
definition.talk_ms: per class, the length of the union of that class's turn intervals (a turn's start_ms/end_ms are the cue's own)
definition.doctor_share: doctor_talk_ms / (doctor_talk_ms + other_talk_ms); null when there is no doctor or no other talk
definition.turns: count of attributed turns per class
definition.interruptions: count of turns that start inside a turn of a different speaker and end after it (a turn nested inside another is overlap, not an interruption)
definition.overlap_ms: length of time covered by two or more speakers at once
definition.longest_monologue_ms: the longest run of one speaker's turns whose gaps are under 2 000 ms
definition.silence_share: 1 - union of all turn intervals / window length (consult: the consult span)
definition.skipped: no_role_layer when the consult has no role track, or the role track or the English text track fails its sha-256 check, or the text is not English, or there is no consult_uid (no fallback to room_turn_speaker); no_diarization when the joined role track gives no attributed turns; role_layer_consult_only for a window unit (the role layer exists per consult only). The window unit is kept in `units` only so that a window run is recorded as skipped and the 0.1.0 window rows (voiceprint era) stay readable by version in rubric_result; it scores nothing.
definition.consult_unit: the consult's REB English text track joined to its role track (llm-roles) by segment time, clamped to the consult span (eta_encounter_windows t_open..t_close). Role-track choice: when the newest role row fails its sha-256 check, the next older VERIFIED ok role row is used (sha-checked, traceable through evidence.role_config_hash); a role track with no verified row is no_role_layer
